d: Election Day 2026 is underway across the United States, with key political leaders and candidates casting their ballots in closely watched races. Ohio gubernatorial candidates Vivek Ramaswamy and Amy Acton vote as they make their final push in a fiercely contested battle for the governor's office. Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer also casts his ballot in Brooklyn, expressing confidence in a Democratic comeback, while Republican Senate candidate Chris Pappas and Iowa Senator Ashley Hinson take part in Election Day voting as voters decide the balance of power in Congress.
